question: Should this owner-authored Claude CLI behavior change be approved after the pending repository checks complete, with live account-side confirmation treated as follow-up evidence rather than a merge gate?
rationale: Repository policy keeps owner-authored pull requests open for explicit maintainer judgment; the remaining uncertainty is production-account behavior that unit tests cannot observe.

options.title: Approve after checks
options.body: Merge the narrow tested fix once required checks pass, and collect redacted authenticated probe evidence when an environment is available.

options.title: Require live confirmation first
options.body: Wait for a redacted account-side before/after count showing repeated probes reuse one Claude session before approval.

recommendation.title: Approve after checks
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow tested fix once required checks pass, and collect redacted authenticated probe evidence when an environment is available.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-owner authorship and the directly affected Claude probe implementation make this the clearest available decision route.
